notes.title: The game will be officially released on June 1st
notes.notes:
The game is composed of various elements such as PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds, Devil May Cry, Darkness, Production Architecture, etc. It is currently in its early stages and new content is added every month
On the crumbling chaotic continent, the ancient demon god tore apart the boundary between reality and the abyss, dragging the world into eternal night. Players take on the role of a cursed 'demon hunter', who is both a survivor and a master of destruction and reconstruction. Here, the brutal survival of PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds, the magnificent battles of Devil May Cry, the dark equipment system, and the free creation of sandbox construction will intertwine into a unique adventure epic.
